properties.description: Intersections of Twy C and Twy D at Rwy 08L-26R.  Hold short line is only 250' after exiting the FBO ramp.  Rwy hold bar is canted which peaks towards the twy.

Intersections of Twy C and Twy D at Rwy 08R-26L. Caution transitioning between the parallel rwys.  Rwy hold bar is canted which peaks towards the twy.  Rwy hold short line is only 380' away after exiting Rwy 08L-26R and 70' south of the Twy B centerline.
